APPLICATION.name: Application
APPLICATION.description: Formal application for a service, benefit, or program.

REQUEST_FORM.name: Request Form
REQUEST_FORM.description: Document initiating a business request or workflow.

CHANGE_REQUEST.name: Change Request
CHANGE_REQUEST.description: Formal request to modify an existing service, process, or system.

BUSINESS_CASE.name: Business Case
BUSINESS_CASE.description: Justification for a proposed investment, initiative, or decision.

PROPOSAL.name: Proposal
PROPOSAL.description: Document describing a proposed solution or course of action.

REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENT.name: Requirements Document
REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENT.description: Specification of business or technical requirements.

APPROVAL_FORM.name: Approval Form
APPROVAL_FORM.description: Document requesting or recording formal approval.

DECISION_RECORD.name: Decision Record
DECISION_RECORD.description: Record of a decision, its rationale, and responsible parties.

AUTHORIZATION_LETTER.name: Authorization Letter
AUTHORIZATION_LETTER.description: Written authorization permitting a specific action.

NON_DISCLOSURE_AGREEMENT.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement
NON_DISCLOSURE_AGREEMENT.description: Agreement governing the protection of confidential information.

OFFER_LETTER.name: Offer Letter
OFFER_LETTER.description: Formal offer of employment or engagement.

INVOICE.name: Invoice
INVOICE.description: Document requesting payment for goods or services.

RECEIPT.name: Receipt
RECEIPT.description: Record confirming a payment or transaction.

PURCHASE_ORDER.name: Purchase Order
PURCHASE_ORDER.description: Formal authorization to purchase goods or services.

REQUEST_FOR_PROPOSAL.name: Request for Proposal
REQUEST_FOR_PROPOSAL.description: Solicitation requesting proposals from potential suppliers.

STATEMENT_OF_WORK.name: Statement of Work

RISK_ASSESSMENT.name: Risk Assessment
RISK_ASSESSMENT.description: Evaluation of identified risks and their potential impact.

AUDIT_REPORT.name: Audit Report
AUDIT_REPORT.description: Document containing audit findings and recommendations.

POLICY_DOCUMENT.name: Policy Document
POLICY_DOCUMENT.description: Formal organizational policy or governing requirements.

CERTIFICATION.name: Certification
CERTIFICATION.description: Document attesting to compliance, qualification, or completion.

STANDARD_OPERATING_PROCEDURE.name: Standard Operating Procedure
STANDARD_OPERATING_PROCEDURE.description: Instructions for executing a repeatable business process.

INCIDENT_REPORT.name: Incident Report
INCIDENT_REPORT.description: Record of an operational, security, or safety incident.

STATUS_REPORT.name: Status Report
STATUS_REPORT.description: Summary of progress, issues, and current activities.

MEETING_MINUTES.name: Meeting Minutes
MEETING_MINUTES.description: Record of meeting discussions, decisions, and action items.

SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.name: Supporting Evidence
SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE.description: Documentation substantiating a request, claim, or decision.

IDENTIFICATION_DOCUMENT.name: Identification Document
IDENTIFICATION_DOCUMENT.description: Document used to establish or verify identity.

CORRESPONDENCE.name: Correspondence
CORRESPONDENCE.description: Written communication associated with a business workflow.

OTHER.name: Other
OTHER.description: Document not covered by another classification.
